df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

g = df.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['price'].nunique()

d = df[df.date=='10/16/25'].copy()

d2 = d.merge(hi, on=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])
d2['excess'] = d2.num_instances - d2['max']
